title: zenith ores
description: this mod adds some new ores, weapons, tools and armors.
body:
explore minecraft like never before! This mod adds brand-new ores, powerful weapons, tools and unique armor sets to Minecraft. From the Overworld to the Nether and the End, each dimension contains special gems and metals waiting to be discovered.

Why did i made this mod?
A few months ago, i was just mining for some diamonds but i missed something, it was a little  boring to mine the same ores over and over again. I started to make a mod with new ores, weapons and that kind of stuff. Now it's finally done i published it so that more people can play it.



this mod adds:
7 new ores (more coming soon)
-Topaz
-Velvetium
-xp ore
-infernium
-chronium
-Cobalt
-infinium

Special weapons:
inferno blade:
 set enemy on fire

Topaz sword:
 gain health boost

velvetium sword:
 gain lifesteal

Chronium wand:
 freeze enemy's in time
  
glass sword:
 high damage but very low durability

And more!
